mux.video_method: Real ffconcat frame durations, millisecond input timebase, VFR H264 at 960px width. Each actual frame is held until the next actual timestamp; last real image held until recording stop. No interpolation.
mux.audio_method: Actual WAV encoded AAC. Piecewise PCM sample-clock timestamp offsets preserve inferred listener replacement gap; no apad/aresample/async, generated PCM or missing-audio synthesis. AAC packet/block rounding and player gap handling remain limitations.
mux.packet_timing_caveat: MP4 represents AAC gaps by extended packet duration until the next packet timestamp. Decoder/player gap behavior can differ; original WAV and callback-clock evidence are authoritative. No gap-filling PCM filter was used.

limitations: One AI-operated baseline, not a human fear study.
45-minute first recorder cap caused by external queue/focus/operator delay before first mission; no45minute designed wait inference.
421.895967s missing first gap includes18hull loss and19.570503distance increase; exact collision/input/exposure unrecorded.
2.208293s rotation gap occurred while first capture UI remained active.
Only explicit paired operator gaps measured; focus and gap states overlap; long unmarked no-input intervals not classified as confusion/fear.
Capture tracking reads rendered geometry; chart assistance uses original visible artwork. These assistance modes and acquired route knowledge are comparison confounds.
Receipt and source counter do not prove full visual/audio delivery. Actual frames/flags and listener PCM are separate evidence.
VFR mux audio alignment is estimated from callback brackets; DSP/device latency, listener swaps, AAC/player behavior and MP4 duration rounding remain.

Zone04 handoff rows with transitioning=true briefly report zero resources before initialized Zone04 values return; these are not counted as collision damage, depletion or death. Current-zone receipt/objective readouts also change context at authority transfer; historical Zone03 observations are preserved separately.
